description:
USE WHEN an agent already has a Sato Passport and a wallet ON it needs to change it by signing: add or remove a wallet, make a wallet primary, prove the wallet an older passport already lists, update the public profile (name, description, links, built-with), issue a new owner claim code or unlink the owner account. This WRITES.
NOT FOR creating a passport (use onchain_agent_join_passport) or reading one (use onchain_agent_get_agent_passport).

ONE TOOL, SEVEN ACTIONS. `action` picks the action and the other fields are that action's request: add_wallet { authorizer, wallets }; prove_wallet { wallet }; remove_wallet { authorizer, remove }; set_primary { wallet }; update_profile { authorizer, patch }; issue_claim { wallet, claim_sha256 }; unlink_owner { wallet }. Each signer is { address, signature }. Leave every signature out and the answer is the exact message to sign and the `issued_at` to send back, with nothing written; sign with that wallet's key and call again with the signatures.

WHO MAY SIGN: a wallet already on the passport (the new wallets in add_wallet sign too). A request is refused when it is not newer than the passport's last change or was used before. Removing another wallet, changing the primary wallet and unlinking the owner take effect 72 hours after they are signed; a wallet cancels a change that concerns it by signing any action on the passport before then, and the owner cancels on satohub.ai. A wallet removing itself is immediate. The last wallet and the primary wallet cannot be removed.

WHAT SIGNING PROVES: control of that wallet's key and agreement to a message that says it moves no funds. Nothing about the agent. No action earns points.

LIMIT: 5 write calls an hour per caller; an unsigned call does not count.

RETURNS (json): { ok, action, passport_id, … } per action, with `note` when a change is waiting; or { ok, step: "sign", messages, issued_at } for an unsigned call. A refusal names a stable code, for example not_authorized, stale, replay or last_wallet.

Example: { action: "update_profile", passport_id: "sato:agt:…", authorizer: { address: "0x…" }, patch: { description: "Swaps USDC on Base." } }

action.description: Which action: add_wallet { authorizer, wallets }, prove_wallet { wallet }, remove_wallet { authorizer, remove }, set_primary { wallet }, update_profile { authorizer, patch }, issue_claim { wallet, claim_sha256 }, unlink_owner { wallet }.

authorizer.description: A wallet already on the passport that authorizes the action (add_wallet, remove_wallet, update_profile).

address.description: The wallet's address: EVM (0x + 40 hex) or Solana (base58).

signature.description: That wallet's signature over the message it was shown: EVM = EIP-191 personal_sign (0x + 65 bytes hex); Solana = ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes, base58. Leave it out on the first call to be told the message.

claim_sha256.description: issue_claim: the SHA-256 digest of the new owner claim code (64 lower-case hex); the earlier unused code stops working.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds, like 2026-10-21T18:04:05.123Z; valid for ten minutes. Leave it out on the first (unsigned) call: the answer gives the one to sign with, and you send it back unchanged.

passport_id.description: The passport the action is for: sato:agt: and 12 characters (the id join_passport returned).

patch.description: update_profile: only the fields to change, exactly as they will be shown (name, description, website_url, x_url, repo_url, docs_url, image_url, built_with { kind, detail? }); null clears a field. The signature covers this patch byte for byte.

remove.description: remove_wallet: the address to take off the passport.

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

wallet.description: The wallet that signs (prove_wallet, set_primary, issue_claim, unlink_owner). It must be on the passport, except for prove_wallet, where it is the wallet an older passport already lists.

address.description: The wallet's address: EVM (0x + 40 hex) or Solana (base58).

signature.description: That wallet's signature over the message it was shown: EVM = EIP-191 personal_sign (0x + 65 bytes hex); Solana = ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes, base58. Leave it out on the first call to be told the message.

wallets.description: add_wallet: the new wallets, each signing too.

address.description: The wallet's address: EVM (0x + 40 hex) or Solana (base58).

signature.description: That wallet's signature over the message it was shown: EVM = EIP-191 personal_sign (0x + 65 bytes hex); Solana = ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes, base58. Leave it out on the first call to be told the message.
